task.description: Validate the ISS-101 test design from TEST-DESIGNER (Step 03). Hard gate before TEST-RUNNER.
acceptance_criteria: Every ISS-101 MUST acceptance criterion has a runnable integration test
Tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL absent

result.summary: Test design for ISS-101 validated. All 6 acceptance criteria are covered by 4 implemented integration tests (TC-ISS-101-01 through TC-ISS-101-04). No SkipZigTest found. Fixtures use distinct per-test UUIDs per test block. TestHarness.init() returns error.MissingTestDatabaseUrl with a printed message when BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent (not a silent skip). Every test wraps its fixture in a transaction that is unconditionally rolled back in deinit() via defer. All SQL uses parameterised queries (\ placeholders). No credentials or secrets in the test file. DLQ gap (AC-2 partial: dead_letter_items not tested) is correctly noted as MINOR and deferred to ISS-303 per the dependency chain. ISS-101 is a pure schema/migration change with no UI interaction; no pipeline test step is required or missing.

issues.description: DLQ entry creation (dead_letter_items row with source_type=TIMER) is not covered by TC-ISS-101-01 through TC-ISS-101-04. This assertion is documented in the Coverage Gap section of tests/specs/ISS-101.md and correctly deferred to ISS-303, which depends on ISS-101 and implements the scheduler path that routes exhausted-retry timers to FAILED+DLQ. The DLQ path cannot be exercised until ISS-303 is implemented. The six acceptance criteria of ISS-101 itself are fully covered.
